summary: Master ARIMA, Prophet, and ML-based time-series forecasting models to optimize demand planning and financial accuracy. Enroll in our expert-led course today.
lede: Time-Series Forecasting for Business teaches you to turn historical data into future projections using statistical and mathematical models with measurable confidence. You will learn to address seasonality, structural breaks, volatile trends, missing data, outliers, and external shocks while developing forecasts that are accurate, explainable, and reproducible. The course moves from foundational theory to practical implementation with ARIMA, ETS, Prophet, SARIMA, state-space models, and XGBoost-based temporal predictions. Using Python-based libraries and advanced Excel analytics, you will build more efficient forecasting workflows, assess uncertainty, and communicate results clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
audienceIntro: This intermediate-level program is built for professionals who manage data-driven planning and need to move beyond basic spreadsheet projections into advanced predictive modeling.
modules: Statistical Modeling with ARIMA and SARIMA
Exponential Smoothing and State Space Models
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of descriptive statistics (mean, variance, correlation) and experience managing business data in Excel. Familiarity with basic programming concepts in Python or R is beneficial but not required, as the course provides templates for all technical exercises.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
